name: Nishi-Sugamo
tagline: Otemachi in 17 minutes and Tokyo in 24 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, served by Toei Mita Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 17 minutes to Otemachi, 26 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 37 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 26.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.2 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 26.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 21.3 m to 27.5 m, a difference of 6.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 久保田病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 至誠堂病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Mita Line.
congestion: Toei Mita Line runs at 146% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 西巣鴨→巣鴨, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Sugamo is ahead on how close the centre is and lower rent.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Sugamo. Nishi-Sugamo adds the Toei Mita Line; Shin-Koshinzuka adds the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line). Nishi-Sugamo is at least 15 minutes quicker to Otemachi and Toranomon. A one-room flat also costs about ¥15,000 more at Shin-Koshinzuka.

neighbours.lead: For lower rent, Nishigahara-Yonchome; for how close the centre is, Nishi-Sugamo.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishi-Sugamo. Nishi-Sugamo adds the Toei Mita Line; Nishigahara-Yonchome adds the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line). Nishi-Sugamo is at least 16 minutes quicker to Otemachi and Toranomon. A one-room flat, though, costs about ¥7,000 less at Nishigahara-Yonchome.

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
白山通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Mita Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
